prompt.main_subject: An adult modern content creator with black hair tied casually with a wooden hairpin, wearing a dark blue comfortable modern linen outfit, preparing food in a modern farmhouse.
prompt.composition_elements: A modern farmhouse open kitchen opens onto a lush vegetable garden. The 15-second storyboard moves from tomato macro close-up to vegetable preparation and warm stove flames, then to a quiet outdoor meal on a raw-wood table.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural transparent sunlight, morning side-backlight on plants, warm realistic stove light, steam in backlight, and a quiet healing ASMR atmosphere without period-drama styling.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Three five-second storyboard beats; use as narrative pacing rather than an API duration parameter.
technical_specs.camera: HD close-up and extreme macro, then full/medium panorama for the meal.
technical_specs.quality: Sony A7S3 or cinema-camera look, 4K/8K ultra HD.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Modern rural aesthetics, cinematic commercial, Sony A7S3 or cinema-camera look, 4K/8K ultra HD, extreme macro, natural transparent light, healing ASMR, and no period-drama feel. In a well-organized modern farmhouse open kitchen with a lush vegetable garden behind it on a sunny day, an adult modern creator with black hair casually tied with a wooden hairpin wears a dark blue comfortable modern linen outfit, clear makeup, and focused serene eyes. From 0:00-0:05, use an HD close-up: morning sunlight side-backlight hits the plants as the creator's clean bare hands pick a bright red tomato with dewdrops from the vine; show fine tomato texture and droplets. From 0:05-0:10, show a spotless lived-in stove area as the creator cuts vegetables with skilled sharp movements; use macro detail on the blade and ingredients, then show orange flames in the earth stove hearth with warm realistic light. From 0:10-0:15, use a panorama/medium shot: an exquisite home-cooked dish is served on a raw-wood table in the yard; the creator sits quietly, tidies hair by the ear, and takes a mouthful while steam rises in backlight and the scene remains quiet enough to suggest wind.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, stiff movements, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
